request.description: quest_cover_v2 requires thumb (560×840, <=512 KiB) and display (840×1260, <=512 KiB), and accepts optional original (uncropped, aspect preserved, <=3000×3000, <=4 MiB). Each file contains name, mime=image/webp and bytes. Duplicate or unknown variants are rejected. Legacy two-variant clients remain supported.

request.description: For content_version>=7, platform_account is conditionally required and must be nonblank after trimming for published service identities and legacy completion forms that use usernames. Missing usernames are rejected before side effects. Explicitly unscoped publications and earlier client versions retain their existing protocol; see QuestEvidence.

routes.description: Content v10 supports explicit identity.version=2: automatic authenticated Questfall identity and screenshot/url without a source account. Individual result links are single-use per quest, even after rejection or republication; exact idempotent replay does not create another submission. Response format 2 is the only supported format and the default when response_version is omitted. Explicit unsupported versions are rejected before the operation.

Appeals require the current decision case_id. Current clients send response_version:2 and an 8–128 character idempotency_key. During the App 0.5.43 rollout, requests omitting both response_version and idempotency_key use a server key scoped to the authenticated actor and decision, so transport retries cannot charge twice. An explicit response_version:2 still requires the key; invalid or empty keys are rejected. All responses use format 2 with entity effects. Author quest details remain restricted to authorized space members; appeal permissions and financial terms are unchanged. Unsupported explicit response versions are rejected before the operation.
